title: Chris Colgan Team Joins Real, Bringing 28 Agents and $150 Million in Annual Sales Volume
summary: Led by national content creator Chris Colgan, the Northern Virginia team has built a leading real estate brand through social media The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX), a real estate technology platform focused on innovation and agent culture, today announced that the Chris Colgan Team has joined the company. The move brings 28 agents to Real and expands the company's presence across Northern Virginia and the greater Washington, D.C., metropolitan area. Led by CEO and Team Leader Chris Colgan, the team is on pace to close approximately $150 million in real estate transactions this year. The team serves clients throughout the Washington, D.C., metro area, including Northern Virginia communities such as Arlington, Alexandria, Fairfax, Loudoun and Prince William counties. Colgan has built one of the region’s strongest brands by combining high-touch service with innovative digital marketing.
